meta.description: A section-level heading row with preamble, title, counter, description, and optional leading and trailing media.

verdict.title: Keep — all findings resolved
verdict.text: Rebuilt on node 4363:11467 in the 2026 Working File and renamed to Section Header. The 8-boolean matrix collapsed to TrailingMedia (4) × hasLeadingMedia (2) = 8 variants; property and layer naming follow the guidelines throughout, with text layers mapping onto §7 hierarchy as Preamble → Title → Description; and both media containers are now real Figma Slots. The nested Counter is the shared component as published, and the row is a static section label so interaction states are deliberately out of scope. All four DS Health traits pass; the only item still open is Code Connect, blocked until the native library exists.

overview.inContextNote: Section headers sit above grouped content — a list of transactions, a set of services, a carousel of offers — to label the section and optionally expose a trailing action.

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Works across many screen sections. TrailingMedia (4) × hasLeadingMedia (2) gives 8 variants with no invalid combinations — every one is a shape a real section actually takes.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Owns its typography, spacing, and color tokens. No external state required.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Renamed to Section Header, freeing the shared prefix. TrailingMedia is PascalCase per §1, hasLeadingMedia uses True | False per §5, and the text layers map onto §7 hierarchy — Preamble → Title → Description.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: Leading media is an Image-Slot and the trailing icon an Icon-Slot, both real Figma Slots; Trailing Media is an instance in every variant that has one; and the count comes from the shared Counter component rather than being drawn in place.

behavior.notes: The only state today — no pressed/disabled/focused.
Link, edit, counter should be real Button/Link instances that carry their own pressed state.
Section headers are informational — no disabled variant needed.
Focus lives on the trailing action, not the header itself.

resolved.headline: Renamed to Section Header.
resolved.body: v2.0: Rebuilt on node 4363:11467 in the 2026 Working File and renamed from Header to Section Header, describing what it actually is — a section-level heading row, not a screen chrome bar. Frees the Header prefix that four structurally different components were sharing. (C1 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Eight boolean props collapsed to two.
resolved.body: v2.0: The 8-boolean matrix with 256 theoretical combinations and 16 built variants is now TrailingMedia (4) × hasLeadingMedia (2) = 8 variants. Fewer than the three props recommended, and every combination is meaningful. (C2 · Property)

resolved.headline: Property naming corrected.
resolved.body: v2.1: hasTrailingMedia → TrailingMedia — a four-value enum should not carry a boolean has prefix (§2) — and hasLeadingMedia values went Yes | No → True | False, which §5 lists explicitly under DON'T. The has prefix is correct on that one because it is a genuine boolean. (C2 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Layer naming completed.
resolved.body: v2.1–v2.2: Two frames both named container became LeadingMedia and HeaderContent; #title → Preamble, #heading → Title, #description → Description, header-description → DescriptionRow, header-counter → CounterSlot. The component-name prefixes are gone per §6, and the text layers now map exactly onto §7 content hierarchy: Preamble → Title → Description. Verified across all eight variants by full text scan. (C1)

resolved.headline: Media containers converted to real Figma Slots.
resolved.body: v2.2: Leading media went from a Placeholder instance to an Image-Slot SLOT in all four hasLeadingMedia=True variants, and the trailing icon is now an Icon-Slot SLOT inside the Trailing Media instance. Teams can drop in real content without detaching. (C6 · Slot)

resolved.headline: Trailing media made consistent across variants.
resolved.body: v2.2: Trailing Media is an INSTANCE in every variant that has one — the Icon variants previously used a plain FRAME — and the stray instance in TrailingMedia=None, hasLeadingMedia=True is gone, so both None variants now match. (C1)

resolved.headline: Nested Counter confirmed correct.
resolved.body: v2.2: Closed by owner decision — the Counter instance points at the Counter component as published, and stays. The rebuilt copy at 4675:21497 is a working-file version rather than a replacement, so no swap is needed. Worth revisiting only if the two ever diverge in the published library. (C4 · Composition)

resolved.headline: Interaction states ruled out of scope.
resolved.body: v2.2: Closed by owner decision — Section Header is not tappable. It is a static section label, so Default | Pressed | Disabled would describe interactions the component never has. Any tap target lives in the trailing media, and its states belong to that component. (C5)

resolved.headline: Header-family restructure closed.
resolved.body: v2.3: Closed for this component. The restructure that mattered here is done — the base component is Section Header, which frees the Header prefix that four structurally different components were sharing, and its own naming, properties and layers all follow the guidelines. Header - With Logo has since been renamed Brand App Bar in Figma, confirming it stays a distinct component rather than merging into Title Bar. What remains is bookkeeping on two other pages rather than work on this one: the site still lists Brand App Bar under its old name, and Detail Hero still needs a call on whether it belongs in the family at all. Both are tracked on their own component pages. (Family)

propertyMapping.description: TrailingMedia and hasLeadingMedia are the set’s two variant properties; hasPreamble, hasDescription and hasCounter are booleans that change what renders without adding variants. Image-Slot (leading) and Icon-Slot (trailing Icon) are Figma Slots; the Counter is a nested Counter instance. Boolean defaults and text exposure are not readable with the plugin.

accessibility.ios: Title carries .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader); Preamble and Description are read as part of it.
accessibility.android: Modifier.semantics { heading() } on the title; mergeDescendants on the content block.

accessibility.ios: .accessibilityValue("3 items") on the heading — the bare number is ambiguous.
Each is its own Button with the visible text as label; .isLink trait on Link.
accessibility.android: Separate TextButton / IconButton with contentDescription; never merged into the heading.

accessibility.ios: .accessibilityHidden(true) when decorative; a label when it identifies the section.
Link (61 × 22) and Edit (112 × 24) need a 44 pt hit area.
accessibility.android: Link and Edit need a 48 dp touch target.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Link when the section continues on another screen — "View All".
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t use Link for an in-place action; that is Edit.

usageGuidelines.doText: Turn hasCounter on only when the count changes what the user does next.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t show a static total in the counter.

usageGuidelines.doText: Keep the Title to one line inside the content width — 312 less leading and trailing media.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t wrap the title; move detail into Description.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use hasLeadingMedia for a section icon or avatar at 46 × 46.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t put an illustration in Image-Slot; the frame is fixed at 46.

scorecard.notes: TrailingMedia and hasLeadingMedia with Title Case values; the three has… booleans are real True / False.
Preamble → Primary/Label/Small, Title → Primary/Headlines/Section, Description → Secondary/Bold/Caption. Colour variable bindings are not readable with the plugin — confirm in Dev Mode.
One enum, four booleans, two slots, three strings — maps 1:1 onto EBSectionHeader.
Interaction states ruled out of scope (v2.x): the header is static; Link and Edit take their states from the Text Button.
Leading and trailing icons are Slots with instance placeholders. The Edit icon carries a shape_full BOOLEAN_OPERATION — flatten it in the icon library.

variants.description: 4 TrailingMedia × 2 hasLeadingMedia = 8 variants; hasPreamble, hasDescription and hasCounter are booleans and do not multiply the count

changelog.header: Style and Code tabs re-read · node 4363:11467

rows.body: Style tab rebuilt from the eight live variants. Cards follow TrailingMedia — Icon, Link, Edit, None — with the four booleans as panel toggles; geometry, colours and the three text styles verified on 4363:11466 and its siblings against the exports, and the preview now top-anchors at 24 like the component. Padding, gap, alignment and colour tokens are not readable with the plugin and stay —.

Code tab regrouped on the TrailingMedia × booleans schema. Property Mapping one row per property with the two slots, Usage Snippets per TrailingMedia, Guidelines added, Scorecard regraded, Variants Inventory on the eight live nodes.
Edit icon carries a BOOLEAN_OPERATION. The Edit icon inside Trailing Media on 4363:11462 contains shape_full; flatten it in the icon library. Filed from the scorecard for the Component Review.

Resolved issues recorded. 9 resolved issues on the Overview tab had no changelog row: Renamed to Section Header; Eight boolean props collapsed to two; Property naming corrected; Layer naming completed; Media containers converted to real Figma Slots; Trailing media made consistent across variants; Nested Counter confirmed correct; Interaction states ruled out of scope; Header-family restructure closed.
Verdict: Restructure — Rename to Section Header, collapse 8 boolean props into 3 slots (preamble, leadingMedia, trailing). Open
Family restructure plan — 4 "Header*" components should be renamed by role; "With Logo" merges into Title Bar; "Transaction" moves out of family. Open
Trailing actions should be real components — Link/Edit/Counter should be Text Button / Icon Button / Badge instances, not drawn in-place. Open
C7 — Code Connect — Blocked until property model collapses. Open
